disambiguation: Affect only the native HTML5 video player for local files; does not modify embedded third-party players.
intentEvidence: This plugin enhances the native HTML5 <video> player used by Obsidian for local video files.
problem: Obsidian's native HTML5 video player lacks advanced, gesture-driven controls suitable for modern mobile video consumption.
summary: A plugin that enhances native HTML5 video player controls in Obsidian with gesture-driven features like horizontal scrubbing and vertical volume adjustment.
